title: Niu Ford Senior Automotive Sales Consultants
description:
Big Brand. Bigger Commissions.
The best salespeople don’t wait for business — they create it. At Niu Ford (Port Moresby), we’re looking for Senior Automotive Sales Consultants who know how to hunt, close, and deliver results that matter.
Representing Ford in Papua New Guinea means selling more than a vehicle — you’re selling a global brand built on trust, performance, and staying power. We want proven performers who thrive on the chase, build relationships that last, and aren’t afraid to ask for the business.
What You’ll Be Doing
This isn’t a role for order-takers. It’s for closers. You’ll manage your own pipeline, prospect actively, win repeat business through relationships, and convert leads into long-term loyalty. Every handover, every test drive, every deal is your stage.
What We’re Looking For
High-energy operators with a strong track record in automotive or high-value sales. You’re confident, disciplined with follow-up, and you know how to build your own market — not wait for walk-ins.
Why You’ll Love Working with Us
You’ll be backed by a serious brand with serious demand — Ford. Expect uncapped commissions, a competitive base salary, and real career progression through PNG Motors’ national network. The harder you drive, the bigger you earn.
How to Apply
